title: Document
description: One imported PDF. Fields follow SDD 5.1 'Document'.

document_id.description: sha256 of the file bytes. Content-addressed, so the same PDF imported twice under different names is one document.

display_title.description: PDF metadata title where present, otherwise the filename stem. Shown in citations, so it is display text and never an identifier.

extractor.description: Library and version that produced the text, e.g. pymupdf/1.28.2. Recorded because a different extractor yields different offsets, which would invalidate stored citations.

import_warnings.description: Non-fatal findings carried forward into the import report. Empty for a clean accept.
